articles.title: Lift Out of Service at Derker Tram Stop
articles.excerpt: The lift at Derker tram stop is currently out of service, affecting access for passengers travelling towards and away from Manchester.
articles.content_html:
A lift at Derker tram stop is out of service until further notice. The announcement was made on 8 August 2026 at 3:37pm.

Passengers travelling towards Manchester can access the Manchester bound platform via a ramp from Cromford Street. For those travelling away from Manchester, step-free access is also available via a ramp from Cromford Street, with a track crossing to reach the Rochdale bound platform.

The disruption may cause inconvenience for users of the tram service, particularly those requiring step-free access.
